note: A decomposition shape. The lemmas are small facts a bare Lean kernel decides on its own, so the example runs anywhere Lean is installed and the audit surface is what it demonstrates: six statements to read over eighteen obligations, and the twelve intermediate ones delegated.

obligations.statement: the domain this mission quantifies over is the natural numbers; nothing in this declaration proves the definition, a reader accepts it
stated but not yet closed; milestone_c is a proof-sketch conditional on this, and closing it elsewhere resolves the sketch without rewriting it
theorem base_b (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := by simp
theorem base_c (n : Nat) : 0 + n = n := by simp
theorem base_d (n : Nat) : n <= n + 1 := by omega
theorem step_a1 (n : Nat) : n + 1 = 1 + n := by omega
theorem step_a2 (n : Nat) : n * 1 = n := by simp
theorem step_a3 (n : Nat) : 1 * n = n := by simp
theorem step_b1 (n m : Nat) : n + m = m + n := by omega
theorem step_b2 (n : Nat) : n - n = 0 := by omega
theorem step_b3 (n : Nat) : n <= 2 * n := by omega
theorem step_c1 (p q : Prop) (h : p) (_ : q) : p := h
theorem step_c2 (p : Prop) (h : p) : p := h
theorem milestone_a (n : Nat) : n + 2 = 2 + n := by omega
theorem milestone_b (n : Nat) : 2 * n = n + n := by omega
theorem milestone_c (n : Nat) : n < n + 1 := by omega
theorem mission (n : Nat) : n + 3 = 3 + n := by omega
